acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing a design-build firm like AKN Design Group for smart kitchen upgrades offers the significant advantage of a single point of coordination. We manage the entire process, from initial design concepts—including CAD-supported layouts for technology integration—through construction, installation, and final walkthrough. This integrated approach ensures that complex smart systems are seamlessly incorporated into your kitchen's aesthetics and functionality, preventing the common pitfalls of disconnected services and guaranteeing a cohesive, high-quality outcome with clear communication throughout.
